text:
sara wong: FYI — Midlands Bank (enterprise) wants a Dedicated POC but needs compliance artifacts before we provision. They listed: SOC 2 Type II (redacted ok), ISO27001 cert, and a vendor-signed pen-test letter. They want everything by next Fri. Can we meet that?

david choi: Quick clarification: do they want the pen-test letter specifically from our external pentest vendor, or will an internal attestation plus the vendor report summary suffice?

lina rogers: They explicitly said "vendor-signed letter preferred" in procurement email. If we can't get it we should tell them ETA.

david choi: Understood. For SOC2 & ISO we can provide redacted PDFs today. For vendor-signed letter we need to ask the vendor for permission to re-sign or issue a customer-specific attestation — that'll take 3-6 business days.

sara wong: Ok please prepare the redacted SOC2/ISO now. Also they asked for a one-page KMS/keys statement and evidence that we don't persist customer plaintext data. Lina, can you write that?

lina rogers: Yes — I'll draft a KMS summary: envelope encryption, customer key separation (if using customer-managed keys), rotation schedule, and no plaintext logs. ETA 4 hours.

security-bot: Automated: Compliance bundle checklist created at //drive.redwood/compliance/pocevidence_midlands_v1.zip (access: sales@redwood.com). Includes template runbook and network diagram template.

david choi: Price question from buyer: if the POC runs 3 weeks on Dedicated, do we charge reserved monthly pricing or pro-rate? Finance wants to know if we can offer a short trial discount.

sara wong: Typical flow: month-of reserved rate for the POC plus a one-time POC credit for enterprise sales. I'll loop in finance.

finance-bot: Automated: Suggested pricing note -- Offer month-of reserved pricing with a 25% one-time credit for POC up to 3 weeks. Confirm with CSM for exceptions.

lina rogers: Uploaded: redacted_SOC2_2024.pdf, iso27001_cert_2024.pdf, kms_statement_midlands.txt to the drive link.
david choi: I'll message the vendor to request the signed pen-test letter and give them the customer's consent form (procurement required). I'll update thread when vendor confirms timeline.
sara wong: Great. My plan: send the redacted bundle + KMS statement to procurement today, note vendor pen-test ETA 3-6bd, confirm pricing note. If vendor can't deliver in time we'll provide internal attestation and vendor summary as interim evidence.
lina rogers: Action items:
- lina: finalize KMS statement and upload (done)
- david: request vendor pen-test letter & track response
- sara: send bundle to customer and include pricing note + fallback plan
sara wong: Tagging @david choi and @lina rogers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
